tools.name: search_banks
tools.description: Look up a US bank by name (legal or common, e.g. "Chase", "state street") and return its FDIC certificate number, city, state and total assets. Use this first: every other tool needs the certificate. Optionally narrow by two-letter state.

tools.name: get_bank_profile
tools.description: Headline profile for one bank from its latest Call Report data: identity, total assets, deposits, loans, ROA, ROE, net interest margin, capital, liquidity and credit ratios, with the reporting period and source. Units are stated on every value.

tools.name: nim_rate_shock
tools.description: Estimate how a Fed funds move changes a bank's loan yield, deposit cost, and net interest income, using its own filed pass-through history. Free; computed from FFIEC filings; results state whether each number is filed, derived, or assumed.

tools.name: margin_capture
tools.description: Compare a bank's loan beta with its deposit beta and rank the spread against its asset-band peers, from FFIEC filings. Free; computed from FFIEC filings; results state whether each number is filed, derived, or assumed.

tools.name: maturity_wall_refinancing
tools.description: Measure time deposits maturing or repricing within a year, then test explicit renewal and replacement assumptions against tier-specific costs. Free; computed from FFIEC filings; results state whether each number is filed, derived, or assumed.

tools.name: deposit_pricing_decision
tools.description: Price holding, matching, or beating the market rate on a bank's deposits: annual cost, balances at risk, breakeven retention, and sensitivity. Free; computed from FFIEC filings; results state whether each number is filed, derived, or assumed.

tools.name: loss_reserve_scenario
tools.description: Stress a bank's net charge-offs: provision needed to hold its allowance ratio and the after-tax hit to CET1 or leverage capital, with peers. Free; computed from FFIEC filings; results state whether each number is filed, derived, or assumed.
